responsibility: This machine description provides the detailed DFA scheduler model for the Broadcom SB-1 and SB-1A cores. It defines the four-way issue resources, load/store, execution, divide, multiply, and dual floating-point pipes, models restrictions such as FP exception handling and 32-bit versus 64-bit FP issue behavior through target attributes, and supplies reservations for integer, memory, branch, HI/LO, divide, and many floating-point operation classes so GCC can schedule code specifically for SB-1 family superscalar pipelines.
